notes.heading: Comparing
notes.text: Toggle the reference against either render. The previous render is the dist-gated recreation, so it should hide the mesh entirely. The revised render draws the head as belt_director.scad's disc and the shank at the press clearance. The dimensions are in belt_director.scad's header. Run render.rs --verify before building this page, because the renders are its output.
